versions.changelog: 补充中英文双语简介与财务、效率分类。Added a bilingual summary and finance and productivity categories.

Initial release of Take Back My Latte.

- Analyze OpenAI Usage and Costs JSON files to show actual spend measured in lattes.
- Report how many lattes could be "recovered" next month and provide estimates based on actual cost data.
- Supports local analysis only—no API key required, no data upload.
- Displays concise cost breakdowns, warnings, and top actionable optimization suggestions.
- Focuses strictly on OpenAI data and avoids dashboard or external provider concepts.
